items.title: ‘Insiders Only Buy for One Reason’: Intel’s CEO Just Bet $10 Million on His Company’s Stock. It’s Now Even Cheaper to Get In.
items.summary: Intel's CEO just put $10 million of his own money into his company's stock at a price the market is now refusing to match. Whether that bet signals a turning point or a costly miscalculation depends on what happens next inside the world's most expensive manufacturing gamble.

items.title: Marvell Leads AI Stocks Lower After Earnings That Narrowly Topped Estimates
items.summary: A day after rallying on the back of strong results from Nvidia, the AI trade is stumbling to close out the week.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: PayPal, Marvell, Gap
items.summary: ↘️ Marvell Technology (MRVL): The semiconductor company reported higher revenue and earnings and lifted its guidance for the current and upcoming fiscal years. Still, shares sank, in the latest example of the high expectations that investors have for companies tied to the AI boom.

items.title: Marvell Falls 7% as Google AI Payoff Lands in Fiscal 2029, Intel Slips, NVIDIA Barely Budges
items.summary: Marvell just posted record Data Center numbers and raised its outlook, yet the stock is getting crushed in early trading. The culprit is a massive Google AI deal that Wall Street wanted years sooner than management is promising to deliver it.
